description: Rule R2. FR-C2-03 and FR-C2-07. A tool message whose token_count exceeds tool_output_token_cap is trimmed to head and tail with the cut marker. The system message and the latest user message stay byte-for-byte. CTX-004 adds R3 duplicate-message handling later.
scope: Trim role tool when token_count is greater than the cap
Keep token_count equal to the cap as action none when no other rule matches
Leave system content and the last user content unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: A tool message with token_count 4001 is rewritten to the first trim_head_chars, the marker, and the last trim_tail_chars. tokens_saved_est is token_count minus the cap. token_count 4000 with context_pct 0.10 returns none. System and latest user contents are unchanged even when their token_count is 9000. FR-C2-03 FR-C2-07.
constraints: Do not alter the latest user message.
Do not alter any system message.
Do not drop CTX-002 behavior. context_pct 0.60 with no oversized tool still returns compact_recommended.
Do not implement CTX-004 duplicate-message behavior in this task. dedupe_key is inert here.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. CTX-003 is R2 trim only; do not implement CTX-004 R3 duplicate-message behavior here.
Every test function for a subtask must contain that slice token, for example CTX_003_2.
After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command. Do not stop with only explanation text.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because CTX-003.1 used the strict greater-than boundary correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not invent extra code.
